issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException while public constructors and SPI registration still hand out instances
issues.detail: Callers instantiating the format via the still-public no-arg constructor get an object that only explodes at write time. This violates the KnnVectorsFormat contract (LSP) and fails at the wrong point. Either fail in the constructor with a message pointing at Lucene104, or introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype that encodes the narrowing in the type system.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields silently demoted from protected to package-private on a still-public abstract class
issues.detail: The class remains public abstract with a public nested subclass, but shared fields lost protected access. External subclasses break without a clear signal. Either make the class package-private/final to seal the hierarchy, or restore protected access. The current half-step leaves a public ADT with no usable extension surface.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant duplicated rather than sourced from one canonical location
issues.detail: Previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat, the constant is now re-declared on Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat. Two sources of truth for an on-disk format parameter is exactly the invariant-drift risk that one-definition discipline prevents. Keep the canonical import, or move it to a shared on-disk-format spec class within backward_codecs.

issues.description: Public symbols (NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) demoted without a deprecation cycle
issues.detail: Previously-public constants and methods on a released format class were demoted to package-private in the same release that relocates the class. This is an ABI break for external code referencing them by name. Keep them public-and-deprecated for one cycle before removal.

issues.description: Constructors still accept numMergeWorkers/mergeExec that are now dead parameters
issues.detail: The constructor validates and then discards numMergeWorkers and mergeExec while the writer throws anyway. The signature lies about behavior. Drop the parameters or document that they exist only for source-compat and are ignored.

issues.description: RW test subclasses re-enable writes via inheritance and leaky package-private access
issues.detail: RW test formats extend the read-only legacy formats and override fieldsWriter, weakening the supertype postcondition and depending on package-private fields. Prefer composition or a protected createWriter() hook on the production class, parameterizing the V0/V1 variants instead of duplicating near-identical scaffolds.

synthesis.summary: The relocation of the Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is directionally right, but the contract work is incomplete. The panel agrees that disabling writes via a runtime UnsupportedOperationException — while public constructors and SPI registration still produce instances — fails at the wrong point and breaks the KnnVectorsFormat contract; encode read-only-ness in the type or fail at construction. OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues' silent protected-to-package-private demotion on a still-public abstract class is inconsistent and needs resolution either way. Secondary concerns: a duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant, undeprecated public-symbol demotions, dead constructor parameters, and test RW subclasses that re-enable writes through inheritance and package-private leakage. Direction approved; cleanup required before landing.
